```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
})

# -------------------------------
# Paths
# -------------------------------
fusion_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/RNAfusion/FusionReports/fusions_in_all_3_callers.tsv"

tcga_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Reference/TCGA.BRCA.onco.genes.OncoVar.tsv"
icgc_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Reference/ICGC.BRCA.onco.genes.OncoVar.tsv"

out_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/RNAfusion/FusionReports/fusions_in_all_3_callers_BRCA_overlap.tsv"

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Helpers
# -------------------------------
clean_partner <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)

  # If like "ELF1(41522),WBP4(671)" -> take first before comma
  x <- str_split_fixed(x, ",", 2)[,1]

  # Remove "^ENSG..." suffix if present
  x <- str_replace(x, "\\^.*$", "")

  # Remove "(...)" suffix like "ELF1(41522)" -> "ELF1"
  x <- str_replace(x, "\\(.*\\)$", "")

  x <- str_trim(x)
  x
}

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Load BRCA gene set (OncoVar)
# -------------------------------
tcga_df <- fread(tcga_file) %>% mutate(Source = "TCGA")
icgc_df <- fread(icgc_file) %>% mutate(Source = "ICGC")
combined_df <- bind_rows(tcga_df, icgc_df)

# Build gene roles (as you did before)
gene_roles <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(Gene_symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    is_oncogene = any(str_detect(
      paste(OncoKB, OncoVar, `2020Rule`, CTAT, HCD, Intogen, Oncogene),
      regex("oncogene", ignore_case = TRUE)
    ), na.rm = TRUE),
    is_tsg = any(str_detect(
      paste(OncoKB, OncoVar, `2020Rule`, CTAT, HCD, Intogen, TSgene),
      regex("tsg", ignore_case = TRUE)
    ), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cancer_role = case_when(
      is_oncogene & !is_tsg ~ "Oncogene",
      is_tsg & !is_oncogene ~ "TSG",
      is_tsg & is_oncogene  ~ "Dual",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

metadata_cols <- c("Gene_symbol", "Gene_biotype", "OncoKB", "OncoVar", "MutPanning",
                   "2020Rule", "CTAT", "HCD", "Intogen", "Oncogene", "TSgene")

gene_metadata_full <- combined_df %>%
  arrange(Gene_symbol, desc(Source)) %>%
  distinct(Gene_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(all_of(metadata_cols))

cgc_df <- left_join(gene_roles, gene_metadata_full, by = "Gene_symbol") %>%
  rename(OverlapGenes = Gene_symbol)

cgc_genes <- unique(cgc_df$OverlapGenes)

cat("Loaded BRCA gene set size:", length(cgc_genes), "\n")

```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Load fusions (3 callers)
# -------------------------------
fus <- fread(fusion_file)
stopifnot("Fusion" %in% names(fus))

fus2 <- fus %>%
  mutate(
    GeneA_raw = str_split_fixed(Fusion, "--", 2)[,1],
    GeneB_raw = str_split_fixed(Fusion, "--", 2)[,2],
    GeneA = clean_partner(GeneA_raw),
    GeneB = clean_partner(GeneB_raw),
    GeneA_in_BRCA = GeneA %in% cgc_genes,
    GeneB_in_BRCA = GeneB %in% cgc_genes,
    BRCA_match = GeneA_in_BRCA | GeneB_in_BRCA,
    BRCA_match_type = case_when(
      GeneA_in_BRCA & GeneB_in_BRCA ~ "Both_partners_BRCA",
      GeneA_in_BRCA & !GeneB_in_BRCA ~ "GeneA_BRCA",
      !GeneA_in_BRCA & GeneB_in_BRCA ~ "GeneB_BRCA",
      TRUE ~ "No_match"
    )
  )

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Summaries
# -------------------------------
n_total <- nrow(fus2)
n_any   <- sum(fus2$BRCA_match)
n_both  <- sum(fus2$BRCA_match_type == "Both_partners_BRCA")
n_A     <- sum(fus2$BRCA_match_type == "GeneA_BRCA")
n_B     <- sum(fus2$BRCA_match_type == "GeneB_BRCA")

cat("Total fusions (3 callers):", n_total, "\n")
cat("Fusions with >=1 BRCA partner:", n_any, "\n")
cat("  GeneA in BRCA:", n_A, "\n")
cat("  GeneB in BRCA:", n_B, "\n")
cat("  Both partners in BRCA:", n_both, "\n")

# -------------------------------
# Save overlap table (only matches)
# -------------------------------
overlap_tbl <- fus2 %>%
  filter(BRCA_match) %>%
  select(Fusion, GeneA, GeneB, GeneA_in_BRCA, GeneB_in_BRCA, BRCA_match_type) %>%
  arrange(desc(BRCA_match_type), Fusion)

fwrite(as.data.table(overlap_tbl), out_file, sep = "\t")

cat("Saved overlap table to:\n", out_file, "\n")
```
